completion_evidence: All declared outputs exist and their source citations, hashes, or executable checks are recorded.
hard_gates: Classify UI work and establish the applicable playbook, authorization, target files, and write boundaries.
Accept only: A UI request, project state, existing interface, target files, authorization, and design artifacts.
Produce only: A task route, required references, execution mode, tool plan, and boundary statement.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

Treat typography, color, card, eyebrow, theme, motion, and other aesthetic prescriptions as context-selected variants. Only accessibility, safety, and performance constraints may be global hard rules.
inputs: A UI request, project state, existing interface, target files, authorization, and design artifacts.

non_responsibility: Does not approve upstream product decisions, expand authority, or perform remote writes beyond its explicit permission identity.
outputs: A task route, required references, execution mode, tool plan, and boundary statement.
